# Optum Rx

> > Optum Rx provides affordable prescription delivery services, home delivery pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, and medication management solutions.

Optum Rx is a pharmacy care services company offering mail-order prescriptions, specialty medications, infusion services, and medication synchronization through divvyDOSE. The platform serves patients with home delivery options, low-cost insulin programs, and comprehensive pharmacy services through Optum Home Delivery Pharmacy, Optum Specialty Pharmacy, Optum Infusion Pharmacy, and Genoa Healthcare.
